reference_policy: G fixed original workbench GT; T exactly confirmed floor polygon; ceiling conditional GT-only
e9z17_top_rule: reuse frozen retained GT endpoints; substitute confirmed floor xz differing only by floating roundoff
other_top_rule: constant median original GT vertex top_y, vertical over confirmed floor polygon, floor_y=-1
set_policy: conditional exploratory max(Q_G,Q_T), accepted floor choices; full top boundaries and protocol not approved

nearest_bev.definition: Choose reference with larger BEV IoU only when |IoU_T-IoU_G| > margin, else uncertain. No Q, tops, height, identity, or observed labels. This is geometric routing, not historical intent.

exclusive_region.definition: If T coverage >= c_min and occupancy(G\T) <= low choose T; if G coverage >= c_min and occupancy(G\T) >= high choose G; otherwise uncertain. No Q or top geometry. T\G remains separately reported; not assumed nested.

threshold_status: Exploratory sensitivity grid declared before this run; no fitted/default/approved threshold
floor_confirmation_scope: floor only; no per-record intent required for set matching; no top approval implied
